description: Header file defining ASN.1 structures and classes for RRC NR UL-CCCH1 message handling, including sequence and choice types for RRC resume requests and message types.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request1_ies_s
classes.description: Structure representing the IEs for RRC Resume Request 1 message.

classes.name: rrc_resume_request1_s
classes.description: Structure representing the RRC Resume Request 1 message.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_type_c
classes.description: Class representing the choice of message type for UL-CCCH1, including RRC resume request and other options.

classes.name: ul_ccch1_msg_s
classes.description: Structure representing the UL-CCCH1 message containing the message type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the structure into a bitstream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the structure from a bitstream.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the structure to JSON format.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value of the choice type.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the current type of the choice.

methods.name: c1
methods.description: Accesses the c1 choice within the message type.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.
